# Fit Coach

> Fit Coach is a mobile-first, installable web app for nutrition and training tracking with an AI coach. Log a meal in a few taps, see live macros against your targets, and get advice from a coach that remembers your history.

## Features

- Meal logging in a few taps from saved meals, recents or a bowl builder, with live macros versus daily targets and separate gym/rest day carb targets.
- Workout logging with a weekly routine, animated demos from a 1,300+ exercise catalog and per-side weight.
- Body composition: InBody result-sheet import from a photo, weight and waist tracking.
- AI coach with memory of your own history that advises like a nutritionist and strength coach, without alarmist messages.
- Bring your own AI provider key; Markdown history import; JSON backup and restore.
- Installable PWA with push notifications.
